description: Trace-derived, loop-generated free text (the trace file's own `reason` field, extracted at earning-health-allslots.sh:86-92) is interpolated, unsanitized, directly into the BLOCKER string passed to self-fix.sh (earning-health-allslots.sh:102), which self-fix.sh then embeds verbatim into the initial TASK prompt (self-fix.sh:75-83) for a detached `tmux`+`claude --model sonnet --dangerously-skip-permissions --add-dir "$HOME"` spawn -- a full-power autonomous coding agent with Bash/Edit/browser access and NO human confirmation gate. There is no sanitization, escaping, or length/charset validation boundary between 'data read from a trace file' and 'text injected into an autonomous agent's system-level task prompt.' This pattern is inherited unchanged from the pre-existing skills/earn/sol-trade/sol-trade-healthcheck.sh:37-52 (not a NEW vulnerability introduced this sprint), but this sprint's explicit purpose is to DRY/generalize this exact mechanism across every future registry-instrumented slot -- meaning every slot added to the registry going forward inherits the identical unsanitized data->prompt boundary by construction, with zero additional review per slot. The spec's Non-functional section (behavioral-spec.md:103-108, 'Money-safety untouched ... no new signing key, no new spend path') addresses signing-key/spend-path safety but does not acknowledge or scope this widened prompt-injection surface for the self-fix spawn.

evidence.snippet:
REASON="$(printf '%s\n' "$TAIL_JSON" | tail -1 | python3 -c '...json.loads(...).get("reason", "unknown")...')"
...
bash "$SELF_DIR/self-fix.sh" "$TARGET" "$ID trace is fresh ... the identical reason '$REASON' -- ..." >> "$LOG" 2>&1
